incident: Native driver's heartbeat thread terminated on Windows atomic file replacement
exception: PermissionError: [WinError 5] Access denied replacing status.tmp with status.json
likely_cause: Concurrent reader holding the destination without delete sharing; no permanent read-only attribute found
mitigation: Separate retrying LIVE_HEARTBEAT observer verifies the actual driver's PID and creation time, object count and log timestamp. Stop polling status.json until the driver exits to avoid interfering with its stage-transition writes.
